name: Never leave a blank — there is no penalty
definition: Math Kangaroo takes nothing off for a wrong answer. A blank scores zero and a guess scores zero or more, so a blank is never the better choice. With one or two choices eliminated, a guess is worth real points across a whole paper.
recognizeWhen: you have no idea how to start
you narrowed it down to two choices
there is no penalty for a wrong answer
misconceptions: I left the ones I could not do blank because guessing felt like cheating.
I ran out of time and did not fill in the remaining answers at all.
I thought a wrong answer would cost me marks.
